title: The CMOS Inverter: Two Transistors, Zero Static Power
topic: CMOS inverter — PMOS to V_DD, NMOS to ground, gates tied to V_in, drains tied to V_out. Only one transistor conducts at a time, so the output flips between V_DD and 0 with essentially no static current. Sweeping V_in across the threshold produces the sharp transfer curve at the heart of every digital logic family.

beats.narration: Stack an N type and a P type MOSFET — and you get a logic gate that wastes almost no power at rest.

elements.content: One P-type on top, one N-type below — meet the CMOS inverter.

beats.narration: V D D on top, ground on the bottom. The P type sits up high, the N type down low, and both gates are wired to the same input.

elements.content: VDD rail at the top, GND rail at the bottom, PMOS source connected to VDD, NMOS source to GND, drains tied together in the middle as V_out, gates tied together as V_in
V_DD, V_in, V_out, GND, P-type, N-type labels appearing in sequence
gates tied — same V_in drives both transistors

beats.narration: Drop V in to ground — the P type turns on, the N type turns off, and V out is pulled up to V D D. Push V in to V D D and the opposite happens; V out drops to ground.

elements.content: V_in input slider sweeping low → high; channel fill of PMOS gradually closes while NMOS channel opens (or vice versa); current path lights up in the conducting branch
V_in numeric readout updating live; V_out numeric readout flipping inversely
V_in low → V_out high   ·   V_in high → V_out low

beats.narration: Plot V out against V in and you get the transfer curve — flat at V D D, a sharp drop at the midpoint, then flat at zero. That sharpness is what makes the gate a clean digital element.

elements.content: Transfer curve traced left to right — flat near V_DD, sharp drop near V_DD/2, flat near 0
Midpoint marker at V_in = V_out = V_DD/2

beats.narration: Only one transistor conducts at any settled input. No path from V D D to ground means almost no static current — that is why CMOS logic dominates.

elements.content: One conducts, one cuts off — no idle current path.
